\begin{table*}[t]
\caption{Admissibility scorecard (extension S1): every cell is a verdict or a value of a stored table. In domain: PICP of the 90\% one-step interval and NLL (nats) on the highD test fold (seed mean). H3.1 and H3.1e: the number of shifted sets (NGSIM I-80, US-101, Waymo, OpenACC) on which the shift rule is supported / refuted / inconclusive (interval verdict). H3.4: the interval verdict with the ACI-online correction on highD, then supported / refuted / inconclusive over the four shifted sets; its part (iii) holds by construction (Section~\ref{sec:res_rollouts}), and every inconclusive cell comes from the event-bootstrap lower bound of the corrected coverage straddling 0.87, so the column does not rank the laws. Platoon (pooled training, OpenACC seen, leader window 61; the exploratory follow-up, not a test of H3.2 as prespecified): the share of rollouts in which a given follower does not collide, averaged over the 20 followers and all 60 profiles (not the share of collision-free platoons; Supplementary Table~S2.3: 19.8\% for the diffusion law, 44.3\% for the GP residual), and the H3.2 reduction of the amplitude CRPS against the IDM + white noise reference on the 47 ACC platoons (response window, 95\% file-cluster interval, verdict). Preview: the leader information the law needs at every re-plan (history only, or the smallest preview horizon at which the H3.2 verdict is supported, extension X1). Cost: platoon simulation time per vehicle-rollout-second on the GPU (Section~\ref{sec:res_cost}). The scorecard summarises; it changes no verdict.\label{tab:c25_scorecard}}
